t.why: A core member of ECOWAS, wary of armed groups spreading from the Sahel to the north.
t.rel: The world's largest cocoa producer. One of the core members of ECOWAS, it is wary of armed groups spreading from Mali and Burkina Faso to the north.
t.know: Its football team, 'the Elephants', is famous.
t.etext: The world's largest cocoa producer, which also grows a lot of cashews and coffee. One of West Africa's fastest-growing economies, with the port of Abidjan as the gateway for landlocked countries.
